items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: So that's Leon White, trombone, and Bill Perkins, guitar, and Eugene Wright on piano and you on saxophone

ctx.x: This little one down here. That's the one. 'Course, we never... We added a tuba player after we got another job but we only had about five who played for the Mexicans--the piano player...and the piano player. He's the piano player... the piano player and the trombone player and the banjo player and the trumpet player and the drummer. That's about all we had--about five or six places--for the Mexican...uh...dances.
So that's Leon White, trombone, and Bill Perkins, guitar, and Eugene Wright on piano and you on saxophone and...uh, probably a drummer but...
